variables.apiPolicyXml:
<!--
  Azure API Management — API-Level Inbound Policy
  Business Operations Assistant / MCP Tools
  
  Named Values consumed by this policy:
    tenant-id            – Entra ID tenant GUID
    functions-base-url   – Azure Function App base URL
    apim-host            – APIM gateway hostname (used in MCP manifest)
-->
<policies>

  <inbound>

    <!-- CORS – allow all origins for demo -->
    <cors allow-credentials="false">
      <allowed-origins>
        <origin>*</origin>
      </allowed-origins>
      <allowed-methods preflight-continue="false">
        <method>GET</method>
        <method>POST</method>
        <method>PATCH</method>
        <method>PUT</method>
        <method>DELETE</method>
        <method>OPTIONS</method>
      </allowed-methods>
      <allowed-headers>
        <header>*</header>
      </allowed-headers>
    </cors>

    <!-- MCP Tool Manifest – return JSON on GET /mcp -->
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(context.Request.Method == "GET" && context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/mcp"))">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="200" reason="OK" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json; charset=utf-8</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>@{
            return "{\"schema_version\":\"v1\",\"name_for_human\":\"Business Operations Assistant\",\"name_for_model\":\"business_ops\",\"description_for_human\":\"Search products, manage inventory, create and track IT support tickets, and search the knowledge base.\",\"description_for_model\":\"Use these tools to help users with product searches, inventory checks, restock ordering, IT helpdesk ticket management, and knowledge base lookups. Always search the knowledge base before creating a ticket.\",\"auth\":{\"type\":\"service_http\",\"authorization_type\":\"bearer\"},\"api\":{\"type\":\"openapi\",\"url\":\"https://{{apim-host}}/mcp/openapi.json\"},\"tools\":[{\"name\":\"search_products\",\"description\":\"Search the product catalog by keyword and/or category.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"q\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Search keyword\"},\"category\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Electronics, Furniture, Office Supplies\"}}}},{\"name\":\"get_product\",\"description\":\"Get detailed information about a specific product by its ID.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"id\"]}},{\"name\":\"check_stock\",\"description\":\"Check the current stock level for a product.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"id\"]}},{\"name\":\"restock_product\",\"description\":\"Create a restock order for a product low on inventory.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"productId\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"quantity\":{\"type\":\"integer\"},\"requestedBy\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"notes\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"productId\",\"quantity\",\"requestedBy\"]}},{\"name\":\"list_tickets\",\"description\":\"List IT support tickets with optional filters.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"status\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"priority\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"assignee\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}},{\"name\":\"get_ticket\",\"description\":\"Get full details of a specific support ticket by ID.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"id\"]}},{\"name\":\"create_ticket\",\"description\":\"Create a new IT support ticket. Always search the knowledge base first.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"title\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"description\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"priority\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"category\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"requestedBy\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"title\",\"description\",\"priority\",\"category\",\"requestedBy\"]}},{\"name\":\"update_ticket_status\",\"description\":\"Update the status of an existing support ticket.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"status\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"notes\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"updatedBy\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"id\",\"status\",\"updatedBy\"]}},{\"name\":\"search_knowledge_base\",\"description\":\"Search the IT knowledge base. Call this before creating a ticket.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"q\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"category\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"q\"]}},{\"name\":\"get_kb_article\",\"description\":\"Get the full content of a knowledge base article by ID.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"id\"]}}]}";
          }</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>

    <!-- JWT Validation – Entra ID Bearer token required -->
    <validate-jwt header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401"
                  failed-validation-error-message="Unauthorized: valid Bearer token required."
                  require-expiration-time="true" require-scheme="Bearer" require-signed-tokens="true">
      <openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{tenant-id}}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration" />
      <audiences>
        <audience>api://apim-mcp-demo</audience>
      </audiences>
      <issuers>
        <issuer>https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{tenant-id}}/v2.0</issuer>
        <issuer>https://sts.windows.net/{{tenant-id}}/</issuer>
      </issuers>
    </validate-jwt>

    <!-- Rate limiting – 60 calls per minute per subscription -->
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="60" renewal-period="60"
                       counter-key="@(context.Subscription.Id ?? context.Request.IpAddress)"
                       increment-condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode < 500)" />

    <!-- Usage tracing -->
    <trace source="apim-mcp-demo" severity="information">
      <message>@{
        var path = context.Request.Url.Path;
        var segments = path.Split('/');
        var toolHint = segments.Length > 0 ? segments[segments.Length - 1] : "unknown";
        return string.Format("[MCP] tool={0} subscription={1} method={2}", toolHint, context.Subscription?.Id ?? "anonymous", context.Request.Method);
      }</message>
      <metadata name="subscription-id" value="@(context.Subscription?.Id ?? "anonymous")" />
      <metadata name="request-path" value="@(context.Request.Url.Path)" />
    </trace>

    <!-- Strip subscription key before forwarding to backend -->
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />

    <!-- Response caching for GET requests – 60 seconds -->
    <cache-lookup vary-by-developer="false" vary-by-developer-groups="false"
                  downstream-caching-type="none" must-revalidate="true">
      <vary-by-query-parameter>*</vary-by-query-parameter>
    </cache-lookup>

    <!-- Backend URL from Named Value -->
    <set-backend-service base-url="{{functions-base-url}}" />

  </inbound>

  <backend>
    <forward-request follow-redirects="true" />
  </backend>

  <outbound>

    <!-- Cache successful GET responses -->
    <cache-store duration="60" />

    <!-- Security response headers -->
    <set-header name="X-Content-Type-Options" exists-action="override">
      <value>nosniff</value>
    </set-header>
    <set-header name="X-Frame-Options" exists-action="override">
      <value>DENY</value>
    </set-header>

    <base />
  </outbound>

  <on-error>
    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
      <value>application/json; charset=utf-8</value>
    </set-header>
    <set-body>@("{\"success\":false,\"message\":\"" + context.LastError.Message + "\"}")</set-body>
    <base />
  </on-error>

</policies>
variables.writePolicyXml:
<!--
  Azure API Management — Operation-Level Policy Override
  Applied to write operations: POST /api/orders/restock, POST /api/tickets,
  PATCH /api/tickets/{id}/status
  
  Validates the request body as JSON and tags the operation as a write.
  Cache-store is skipped because APIM does not cache non-GET responses.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <validate-content unspecified-content-type-action="prevent"
                      max-size="65536"
                      size-exceeded-action="prevent"
                      errors-variable-name="contentErrors">
      <content type="application/json" validate-as="json" action="prevent" />
    </validate-content>
    <set-header name="X-Operation-Type" exists-action="override">
      <value>write</value>
    </set-header>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
